summary: Convergence oracle pins its droppable kinds and tests them against the retention policy (#4869)

replay.detail: Only the convergence test oracle changes.

schema.detail: No claim, registry or storage schema change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and RULES_VERSION are unchanged. The oracle accepts the same droppable kinds as before, now from its own list, which a fast test keeps equal to the set retention.toml derives.

compatibility.detail: No production behavior changes, so mixed-version fleets with the previous release are unaffected.

downtime.detail: Test-only change; no deployment or restart.

manual.detail: No user configuration or setup change.
